content:
**Whitespring Service Entrance** is a location in the Whitespring Resort in Appalachia.

The back entrance of the Whitespring, near the delivery bay, parking lot, and dumpsters.

The service entrance is an alternate entrance to The Whitespring Bunker. [1] [2] It leads directly to the bunker's production area, without needing to traverse a vault door or elevator. In a dumpster area directly next to the service entrance are dozens of corpses, being swept up summarily by a Mister Handy. 

Nearby are several root pods, in a corridor leading back out to the main entrance. Several green Whitespring shuttle buses are parked near the doorway in the parking lot.

The Whitespring Service Entrance appears in *Fallout 76*.
